text:
7.4.2 Go to sleep process
The transition into sleep mode significantly differs between master and slave nodes.
The LIN master node sends a go-to-sleep command when requested by upper layer to
set all slave nodes on the bus to sleep mode.
The LIN slave node enters sleep mode either by reception of a go-to-sleep command
or by detection of bus inactivity.
